title: I have an Idea for a tool and would like opinions
author: KaseyNorth
selftext:
The idea is this:

An AI-powered community and social media manager for indie game developers. Moderate Discord, monitor Steam reviews, and grow your player base while you focus on building your game.

The agent can be easily configured and is a 24 hour assistant that makes the repetitive, boring community and social media tasks that do not involve developing the game easy to complete.

By easily configured, it only does what you tell it to do

if you don't want it to:  
Respond for you  
Help you Write content  
Help you do research

it won't.  

I always hear that developers dread marketing, and not only is it one of the hardest tasks for them, but it makes the whole process less....fun

One time I even spoke with a developer that did not even do outreach

Not promoting anything, or selling anything just trying to garner feedback

I've been talking to developers and researching for quite some time. Yes building a good game is essentially more than half the battle, but there are some devs who I know for a fact make good games and cannot get them noticed

When they do, social media and community become a full time job on top of development

comments.author: Elegant_Gas_740
comments.body: Great idea tbh, indie devs hate the constant community/marketing grind. If your tool can moderate, summarize feedback, draft posts, and flag issues while staying fully controllable, a lot of devs would use and pay for it.

replies.author: KaseyNorth
replies.body:
Thanks for the feed back. are you a developer? what are somethings you wish could be streamlined or handled altogether?

For some, they wouldn't want AI responding to their concerns directly, and in most cases I agree. My idea for the application is to have most backend work that isn't directly tied to communication with players (unless of course the developer wants that and does not mind)

comments.author: sense-net-mccoy
comments.body: As long as my AI can be schizophrenic and crazy, I'll consider it.

replies.author: KaseyNorth
replies.body: the plan is for you to be able to customize its personality, so yes that's an option

comments.author: khull123
comments.body: So clawdbot but just for discord, like discord bot?

replies.author: KaseyNorth
replies.body: No, way more than that. Discord would just be a tool it can use
